items.description:
Magenta Plant Distributors is a wholesaler and exporter of quality plants, operating from premises at the corner of Lynnwood Road and Stangketting Street in Pretoria East, within the Wapadrand area. The business describes itself on its own site and company page as a wholesaler and exporter of quality plants, a description reflected in a long-running social media following of well over a thousand people who have engaged with or visited the business over time. As a wholesaler and exporter rather than a typical retail nursery, Magenta Plant Distributors supplies plant stock in bulk, serving customers such as garden centres, landscaping contractors and other resellers who need plant material sourced in volume rather than individual pot plants.

Its position in Pretoria East, close to the Lynnwood Road corridor, gives it reasonable access to surrounding suburbs and to other garden-related businesses across the greater Pretoria area. The company maintains an online presence so trade customers looking to source plants wholesale or arrange export orders can get in touch directly.

Makhadabi Group of Companies, based on Charlotte Maxeke Street in Pretoria West, is a multi-disciplinary company combining engineering consulting with vehicle repair services. Its consulting and projects division covers civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering work, aimed at improving the quality of both design and construction processes for its clients. Alongside this, the company operates an auto dent removal service, treating customers' vehicles with what it describes as the same level of care it would give its own cars, and a panel beating division handling body repairs and accident repair work as an established auto repair facility. The group also lists glass and windscreen services, and a further line of business it refers to on its site as Fuenergy. The company states that its services are built on values including integrity, honesty, accuracy and commitment to each project.

By combining engineering project consulting with motor body and glass repair work under one group, Makhadabi Group of Companies is able to serve both construction-sector clients and vehicle owners from its Pretoria West base.

Martinique Property Management, based in Wierdapark, Centurion, was founded by a group of senior business people with many years of experience in both the sectional title and full title property environments. The company manages more than 100 full title and sectional title schemes, including residential estates and security villages, across the greater Gauteng province, covering more than 4,000 residential units in total. Its associated insurance brokerage holds more than R2.5 billion worth of fixed property under insurance, while the scheme levy turnover it handles exceeds R4 million.

Each management unit, supported by an accounts assistant and a financial officer, oversees a maximum of 15 to 20 complexes at a time, a structure the company says keeps staff turnover low and preserves continuity in its relationships with the schemes it manages. Services offered include management of full titles, sectional titles, residential estates and office parks, along with debt collecting for schemes recovering outstanding levies from owners.

items.description:
This McDonald's restaurant trades from Irene Village Mall on Mezereon Crescent in Irene Farm Villages, Centurion. According to the franchise's own listing for the branch, it operates from six in the morning until eleven at night on weekdays, then stays open around the clock from Friday through Sunday. The menu spans breakfast items, chicken and beef options, vegetarian choices and salads, desserts and shakes, and a happy meal range for children, alongside the McCafe coffee offering. Customers can eat in, use the drive-thru for a quicker visit, or stop in just for a McCafe coffee on the way past. The restaurant positions itself as a family-friendly stop within the mall precinct, serving the surrounding Irene Farm Villages and wider Centurion area with the chain's standard range of burgers, fries and chicken nuggets alongside its milkshakes and soft serve.

Its location inside Irene Village Mall gives it convenient reach to shoppers and residents in and around Irene throughout extended trading hours.

Metier Concrete Centurion, based in Lyttelton Manor, trades as part of Metier Mixed Concrete, a specialist in concrete solutions ranging from standard ready-mixed concrete through to more specialised products such as fibre-reinforced concrete, coloured concrete and durability concrete, as well as mixes designed for a client's specific project. Its products are designed by in-house concrete technologists in line with SABS SANS 2001 CC-1 specifications, with raw materials sampled and tested according to SANS 1083. The company lists a number of completed contracts among its past work, including supply to the Unilever Indonsa Plant and the Liberty Office Complex and Hotel in KwaZulu-Natal, and to the Metropolis on Park and Discovery developments in Gauteng. This track record on corporate and commercial projects sits alongside its day-to-day ready-mix supply for construction sites across the Centurion area.

From its Lyttelton Manor base, Metier Concrete Centurion serves builders and contractors needing concrete engineered to a specification rather than only a single standard mix.

Michael Tree Felling, based in the Dorandia area of Pretoria North, specialises in tree felling and related grounds work. Its services include site clearing, big tree removals, stump removals, and palm trimming and cutting, along with bush cleaning and paving and lawn work, offered to clients across Gauteng rather than only within its immediate neighbourhood. The company offers free quotations for jobs before work begins, a practical option for property owners wanting cost certainty before committing to large tree removal or site clearing work.

Operating in the wider Pretoria North and Akasia area, Michael Tree Felling positions itself as a specialist contractor for jobs that go beyond routine garden maintenance, such as removing large or difficult trees, clearing bush on undeveloped land, and preparing sites before paving or landscaping begins. Its combination of tree felling with paving and lawn services means a property can go from overgrown or tree-covered through to a cleared, landscaped state using a single contractor.

items.description:
MJ Group of Companies operates a specialty mobile phone shop in Erasmia, Pretoria, offering smartphones, devices and software through in-store shopping. According to its own business listing, knowledgeable staff at the Willem Erasmus Street premises help customers compare models in person, assisting shoppers in finding a suitable device for work, study or everyday use rather than simply selling off a shelf. The shop is described as a straightforward, customer-focused retailer rather than a large chain outlet, with a wheelchair-accessible parking area at the premises. Because it operates as an in-store retailer, customers visiting MJ Group of Companies deal directly with staff who can talk through device options, software needs and accessories before a purchase is made.

Its location on Willem Erasmus Street places it within reach of residents and businesses across Erasmia and the surrounding Centurion area looking for mobile phone and basic computing support without needing to travel further into Centurion or Pretoria.

MLK Corporation, founded in 2017 and based in Lotus Gardens, is a construction firm offering site surveying, quantity surveying, project and construction management, and general building works. Its site surveying service covers levelling and setting out, identifying and analysing structural defects together with proposed repairs, and advising on construction design and management regulations before building work begins. The quantity surveying side of the business handles estimating and pricing, preparing bills of quantities, taking site measurements, and compiling final accounts and interim certificates as a project progresses. On project and construction management, the company manages elementary programming, quality control and production scheduling, oversees sub-contractors and on-site personnel, and assists with executing the building contract from start to finish.

The company describes using electronic devices on-site and in its offices to support accuracy through each stage of a build. It operates Monday to Friday, giving clients a single point of contact across the surveying, management and construction stages of a project.

Momentum Consult Lyttelton operates as a franchise within the Consult financial advice network, which reports more than R65 billion in assets under advice across around 300,000 clients, served by over 500 financial advisers working from more than 300 franchises nationally. Through this network, the Lyttelton practice offers financial planning across several areas: protecting a client's income and lifestyle through life cover, income protection, disability cover and critical illness cover; protecting health through medical aid, gap cover and hospital plan advice; and protecting assets through commercial, agricultural, motor and household insurance.

On the wealth side, advisers at the practice assist with wealth management, investments, private wealth planning, retirement planning and tax-free savings. The franchise structure means clients dealing with the Lyttelton practice draw on the research, products and back-office support of the wider Consult network while working with a locally based financial adviser, including help with wills and estate planning.

MTY Services, based in Queenswood, Pretoria, is a web design and digital services provider aimed at business clients. Its offering spans website design, digital printing, internet marketing, bookkeeping and computer support, delivered either on-site at a client's premises or online, with appointments required rather than open walk-in access. This appointment-based structure lets the business schedule focused sessions for each client rather than running an open-access shopfront. The range of services, spanning digital work such as web design and marketing alongside more administrative work such as bookkeeping, means a single small business client can use MTY Services for several different support needs rather than engaging separate suppliers for each one. The premises include wheelchair-accessible parking for visiting clients.

Based in Queenswood, the company is positioned to serve businesses across the wider Pretoria area, with its mix of on-site and online appointment options letting it support clients who prefer an in-person consultation as well as those happy to deal with the business remotely.

Mvula Borehole Drilling, based in Villieria, Pretoria, provides borehole drilling, water surveying, pump installation and borehole maintenance services. Work begins with a geological survey to assess the site before drilling proceeds at the identified spot, with the company keeping clients updated throughout on drilling depth, costs and geological findings as the hole is sunk. Once a borehole is complete, Mvula can plan and carry out pump installation, with the recommended pump size based on factors including the client's water demand, the depth of the hole and the actual yield of water found. Depending on the geological formation encountered, the company may advise a rest period for the borehole before a pump is installed.

On pricing, the company includes six metres of steel casing as standard, with additional casing and additional drilling charged per metre beyond that. This structured, survey-first approach to pricing and installation is aimed at giving clients in the Villieria area and wider Pretoria clarity on costs before work begins.

NFC Attorneys, based in Wapadrand, is a legal practice offering services covering anti-nuptial contracts, civil litigation, consumer law, conveyancing, property law and real estate, corporate and commercial law, criminal law, debt collection, deceased estates, family law, information and communications technology law, insolvencies, liquidations and business rehabilitations, and labour law. The firm says it has invested in legal research resources, including access to case law and legislation databases, Deeds Office search tools used for property and conveyancing work, and tracing and credit information systems used in debt collection matters.

For anti-nuptial and prenuptial contracts specifically, the firm runs clients through an online questionnaire to gather the information needed for a first draft, which is sent for review and comment before a meeting is arranged for final signing and notarisation. This combination of a wide service range with structured, resource-backed processes for matters such as prenuptial contracts reflects a firm set up to handle both routine conveyancing work and more specialised commercial and family law matters for clients in Wapadrand and the wider Pretoria area.

Nimbus Solutions, based in the Buffelsdrift area of Erasmusrand, Pretoria, develops workflow and security software aimed at businesses operating in logistics, security and compliance-heavy industries. Its product range includes visitor management systems built for secure, streamlined access control at client sites, and electronic proof of delivery tools that use sign-on-glass technology to give real-time tracking and accuracy for goods and services being delivered. The company also offers broader workflow optimisation tools designed to give businesses real-time visibility over their operations, built to be scalable and customisable rather than offered as a single fixed product. According to the company, its aim is to help businesses regain control over day-to-day operations by tackling inefficiencies, security vulnerabilities and operational bottlenecks through a connected suite of tools rather than solving each problem in isolation.

By combining visitor management, proof-of-delivery and general workflow software under one offering, Nimbus Solutions is positioned for businesses needing to manage both physical site access and the tracking associated with deliveries and compliance.

NODI PRINTS, based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, is a print and design business offering custom stickers, DTF transfers and branded apparel, alongside large-format and general digital printing. The company ships custom stickers and transfers nationwide rather than limiting sales to walk-in customers, while still running a physical shop for items such as personalised mugs, corporate branding and apparel printing. Its apparel range covers branded items including golf shirts, body warmers and outdoor shirts, catering to businesses wanting staff or promotional clothing printed or branded to order. The business has been named a finalist in the large-format category of the GAPP awards, a recognition within the printing and signage industry. Customers can track orders and access a client portal online, giving repeat business customers a way to manage jobs without needing to visit or call the shop for updates.

Positioned within the Kosmosdal area of Centurion, NODI PRINTS serves both walk-in retail customers looking for personalised items and corporate clients needing branded apparel or large-format printing produced to order.

Noltrix is a solar energy company based in Annlin, Pretoria, offering the design and installation of solar power systems and, through its Noltrix Training Academy, courses aimed at building hands-on, industry-relevant skills for people entering the solar energy field. The academy's offering includes training aligned with the PV GreenCard scheme, a recognised safety and competency standard within the South African solar installation industry, giving graduates a credential they can use when seeking solar installation work. For solar system clients, the company designs and installs the systems it sells rather than only reselling equipment supplied by others, with its own team handling each installation. For training clients, the academy structure offers a pathway from classroom or workshop-based learning through to practical, hands-on skills intended to prepare people for roles as solar energy professionals.

Based in Annlin, the company serves both residential solar clients and training students across the greater Pretoria region, combining practical installation work with skills development in the solar industry.

Novu Interiors is an interior design studio offering a full range of services from initial concept through to completed, furnished spaces. Its work covers interior design and remodelling, furniture sourcing and procurement, project management, and fully turnkey solutions that take a space from the first idea through to final delivery, supported by 3D renders so clients can see a design before committing to it. The studio also works on new development interiors, giving newly built properties their own distinct identity rather than a generic finish. Its portfolio spans commercial, healthcare and residential projects, reflecting a client base that goes beyond typical home interiors into more specialised commercial and healthcare environments.

Based in the Heritage Hill Estate area of Centurion, Novu Interiors describes its reach as national, taking on projects across South Africa rather than only within the greater Pretoria area. Clients can choose how much of the process to hand over, from a single service such as furniture sourcing through to full turnkey project management covering design, procurement and coordination of an entire job.

Nxlevel Consulting, based in Rooihuiskraal within the Blue Valley Golf Estate area of Centurion, is a strategic consultancy working at the intersection of digital transformation, technology, and the events and exhibitions industry across Africa. Its digital transformation service maps a client's current operations, sales and customer experience processes, then designs and leads the organisation through a future state built around digital tools rather than simply recommending new software. A second service line, innovation strategy, focuses on deploying emerging technology to help organisations stay competitive as their markets change. The firm has deep roots in the exhibitions and congresses sector, drawing on more than two decades of combined industry experience to advise organisations in that space on strategy, technology adoption and growth. Across its history, the consultancy reports having delivered more than 50 projects across more than a dozen African markets and roughly 15 different industry sectors.

From its Centurion base, Nxlevel Consulting positions itself as a specialist partner for organisations seeking to modernise operations or plan major events and congresses across Africa.

Oasis Water's Doornpoort branch operates from Shop 19 in the Doornpark Shopping Centre on Airport Road, Doornpoort, as part of the wider Oasis Water franchise network. The branch is formally classified as a bottled water supplier, reflecting its core business of producing and selling purified drinking water to retail customers rather than operating as a general convenience store. Operating from within a shopping centre gives the branch regular passing foot traffic from other Doornpark tenants and shoppers, rather than relying only on destination visits. As with other Oasis Water branches, the Doornpoort outlet is set up for walk-in retail customers refilling water containers or buying bottled water, serving households and businesses in the surrounding Doornpoort area who want an alternative to tap water without travelling into central Pretoria.

Its location within an established shopping centre on a main route such as Airport Road also makes it a convenient stop for people already visiting the centre for other shopping needs.

items.description:
Optimatix, based in Midstream Estate, is the company behind Tactix, a South African-developed supply chain planning tool built specifically for the local market. Tactix is designed to be ERP-agnostic, meaning it can integrate with a business's existing systems rather than requiring a company to replace its core software before adopting the tool, and the same team that develops Tactix also supports clients through its implementation.

Optimatix offers both standardised and customised planning solutions, serving small businesses as well as large multinational clients from the same platform base. Its services span demand planning, which aims to produce accurate, data-backed sales forecasts aligned with real-world demand, inventory optimisation aimed at reducing stock-holding costs while maintaining service levels, and replenishment planning intended to ensure the right products are available at the right place and time. Through this combination of purpose-built software and hands-on implementation support, Optimatix positions itself as a supply chain partner for businesses working to align supply, demand and operations.

Orange Juice Technology Solutions, based in La Montagne, Pretoria, is a black-owned, Level 1 BBBEE-rated information technology provider offering cybersecurity, cloud computing and broader digital transformation services to business clients. The company positions its work around building secure, scalable systems rather than selling single IT products, pairing cybersecurity services with cloud infrastructure and digital transformation strategy for clients moving away from older, on-premise ways of working. To deliver this, Orange Juice Technology Solutions partners with a number of established international technology vendors, including Adobe, Fortinet, BlackBerry, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services and Sophos, giving it access to recognised security, cloud and software platforms it can deploy for clients rather than relying solely on in-house tools. Its Level 1 BBBEE status is also relevant for South African clients needing to meet their own procurement and empowerment targets when selecting an IT supplier.

Based in La Montagne, the company serves business clients across the greater Pretoria area looking for cybersecurity, cloud and digital transformation support from a single, locally based provider.

OrbFusion, based in the Buffelsdrift area of Erasmusrand, provides business process management software aimed at automating and streamlining day-to-day operations for businesses. The company recently marked ten years in business, a milestone it described as a decade spent refining its approach to business process management. Its product news highlights several areas of focus, including streamlining procurement processes to improve efficiency, control and flexibility, and integrating its BPM software with the On Key Plus enterprise asset management system so that process management and asset management can work together rather than as separate systems. More recently, the company has added AI-driven invoice management functionality, aimed at giving businesses more control and efficiency over how invoices are processed. Rather than offering a single fixed product, OrbFusion builds its platform around configurable workflow solutions and industry-specific extensions that can be adapted to a client's particular processes.

From its Erasmusrand base, the company positions itself as a long-established, locally based alternative to larger international BPM vendors.

items.description:
Outdoorphoto, in Waterkloof Glen, is a camera and photographic equipment retailer selling both online and in-store. Its range covers mirrorless, DSLR, compact, action, video, instant-film and traditional film cameras, together with drones and surveillance cameras, lenses, sound and video equipment, studio lighting, optics, bags and general accessories, sourced from major brands including Canon, Nikon, Sony and Sigma. The store also stocks used camera gear alongside new equipment, giving customers a lower-cost entry point into some products. Outdoorphoto offers free shipping on orders over a set value, allows returns within 30 days for an exchange, and provides customer support through online chat with staff able to advise on equipment choices rather than leaving customers to work it out from product listings alone.

Positioned as a specialist rather than a general electronics retailer, Outdoorphoto serves both amateur and more serious photographers across the greater Pretoria area from its Waterkloof Glen premises, combining in-person advice with the convenience of online ordering for customers unable to visit the store directly.

Outlaw Earthworx, based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, hires out tractor loader backhoes (TLBs), tipper trucks, dropsides and a range of earthmoving equipment including excavators, loaders and graders. Its TLBs are offered for digging, trenching and material handling on both small construction jobs and larger excavation projects, while its tippers and trucks are aimed at heavy-duty hauling work such as moving soil, gravel and construction debris to and from a site. For larger or more complex earthmoving jobs, clients can request that a permanent supervisor be assigned to the site to help manage the work and keep the project on track, rather than only supplying machinery and leaving oversight entirely to the client. The company positions its fleet as suited to terrain of varying difficulty, with equipment kept well maintained so machinery is available and ready when booked.

Outlaw Earthworx aims to serve everything from small residential excavation and site clearing jobs through to larger construction and transport-related earthmoving projects across Pretoria.

Pearson Accountants, based in Rietondale, provides accounting and statutory registration services aimed primarily at businesses rather than only individual taxpayers. Beyond general bookkeeping and accounting work, the firm handles a range of specific registrations on behalf of clients, including VAT registration, turnover tax registration, PAYE and UIF registrations, CIDB registration for contractors, customs import and export registration, and NPO tax exemption registration for non-profit organisations. This spread of registration services suggests a client base that includes smaller businesses needing to get formally registered with the relevant authorities as they grow, as well as contractors and non-profits with their own specific compliance requirements. The firm describes its approach as reliable and transparent, tailoring services to a client's specific trade and the legislation that applies to it, rather than offering a single standard accounting package to every client.

Pearson Accountants operates Monday to Friday from eight in the morning until four in the afternoon, remaining closed on weekends and public holidays, and is positioned to serve businesses across the surrounding Rietondale suburbs needing both ongoing accounting support and one-off statutory registrations.

items.description:
This PEP store trades from Shop 31 in the Centurion Lifestyle Centre, on the corner of Lenchen Avenue and Old Johannesburg Road in Hennopspark. As with other PEP stores, it sells affordable clothing, footwear and general merchandise as part of the wider PEP retail chain, which operates stores across South Africa. According to a listing for this specific branch, the store is open seven days a week, running from nine in the morning until six in the evening on weekdays, from eight until four on Saturdays, and from nine until two on Sundays, giving shoppers a consistently long window to visit across the week including weekends.

Positioned within the Centurion Lifestyle Centre, the store sits alongside other retail tenants, making it a convenient stop for shoppers already visiting the centre for other errands. As part of a large, well-established retail chain, the Hennopspark branch benefits from the group's buying power on everyday clothing and household items, while still operating as a physical, walk-in store for the local Centurion community.

Perfect Water Sinoville supplies purified and prepared water to the public from its premises on Braam Pretorius Street in the Sinoville and Magalieskruin area of Pretoria. The business purifies its water through reverse osmosis, a filtration method that forces water through a fine membrane to remove dissolved particles and contaminants, producing the purified water it sells to walk-in customers. Alongside its water supply and refill service, Perfect Water Sinoville also specialises in home filtration, fitting filtration systems for customers wanting purified water on tap at home rather than only buying bottled or refilled water from the shop. This combination of a retail water point with a home filtration installation service means customers can either collect or buy purified water directly from the premises, or have a filtration system installed in their own home for an ongoing supply.

Based in the Sinoville and Magalieskruin area, the business serves households and smaller businesses in the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs looking for an alternative to municipal tap water, whether through occasional refills or a permanent in-home filtration setup.

Phahlo Ya Kgwebo is a Level 1 BBBEE-rated business resources and services provider based on Nagtegaal Street in Silverton, within the greater Tshwane area. As a Level 1 BBBEE entity, it holds the top broad-based black economic empowerment rating available under South Africa's BBBEE codes, a status that can matter to corporate customers who need to meet their own procurement and empowerment targets when selecting suppliers of business support services.

Operating from Silverton gives the business a base within the eastern industrial and commercial corridor of Pretoria, with reasonably convenient access to surrounding suburbs and business parks across the greater Tshwane metropolitan area. As a business resources and services provider, the company positions itself to support other local businesses with back-office or compliance-related functions that let smaller operators focus on their core trade. Its Level 1 BBBEE rating is likely to be a central part of its own value proposition to corporate clients working to meet empowerment procurement requirements in and around Tshwane.

Picasso Paints Waterkloof, trading from Waterkloof Corner, is part of a paint retail business established in 1992. The store stocks decorative and waterproofing paint products alongside Luxor automotive paint products and Coprox industrial coatings, positioning itself as a specialist paint retailer rather than a general hardware store. It offers a price-match style guarantee, aiming to beat the price of an identical product found cheaper elsewhere, subject to its own terms and conditions. Beyond simply selling paint, the business describes providing personal, expert service both in-store and on-site, helping customers work out practical paint solutions for a particular surface or application rather than leaving them to choose unaided. The company states its ambition is to be recognised as a leading Dulux and Plascon retailer in the Tshwane area, built on this combination of competitive pricing and hands-on technical advice.

Operating from the Waterkloof Corner centre, Picasso Paints Waterkloof serves homeowners, contractors and businesses across the Waterkloof area needing decorative paint, waterproofing products or automotive paint supplies, backed by more than three decades of experience in the paint retail trade.

This Pick n Pay store, anchoring the Byls Bridge Promenade centre in Highveld, Centurion, is open seven days a week, trading from eight in the morning to seven at night on weekdays, eight to four on Saturdays, and eight to three on Sundays. The store has an on-site parking lot for customers, making it straightforward to stop in for a full grocery shop rather than only a quick errand.

As part of the Pick n Pay chain, the branch benefits from the group's buying scale on fresh and packaged groceries, while still functioning as a local, walk-in supermarket for shoppers in the Highveld and wider Byls Bridge area. Pick n Pay promotes regular deals and recipe content to customers of its stores generally, giving shoppers at this branch access to the chain's wider promotional offers alongside everyday grocery shopping. As the anchor tenant of Byls Bridge Promenade, the store draws shoppers who are also visiting other retailers in the centre, making it a convenient single grocery stop within a mixed-use retail precinct in Centurion.

Its position near Wonderpark Shopping Mall places the shop within reach of shoppers already visiting the mall precinct, as well as residents of Karenpark and the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs. By combining a wholesale meat supply operation with a retail-facing biltong deli, Pioneer Biltong is able to offer the range and sourcing scale associated with a wholesaler while still serving individual customers walking in for a direct purchase, giving it a role in both the bulk supply side of the biltong trade and everyday retail sales in the Karenpark area.

items.description:
Plastic Welding Solutions by Plasmus, based in Kilner Park, specialises in welding pure plastics for fabrication and repair work. According to the business's own description, it is expert in welding materials including HDPE, PVC, PP, PS, PC, ABS and PA, covering most of the common pure plastics used in industrial and commercial applications. Rather than working across all types of plastic generally, the business focuses specifically on pure, weldable plastic types, a narrower specialism that requires matching welding technique and equipment to the particular plastic being joined or repaired. This fabrication-focused offering suits clients needing custom plastic components built from scratch as well as those needing existing plastic items, tanks, piping or fittings repaired rather than replaced.

Based in Kilner Park, Plasmus serves industrial and commercial clients across Pretoria who work with plastic components in their own operations, whether that means commissioning new fabricated parts or needing damaged plastic equipment welded back into working condition rather than scrapped and replaced entirely.

Platinum Clothing and Promotions, based in the Garsfontein Smallholdings area, supplies corporate wear and promotional gifting, covering footwear, safety wear, hospitality clothing, custom-made garments and branded promotional items. The company positions its service as covering the full process rather than just supplying blank stock, handling manufacturing, branding and delivery of finished corporate wear and gifting orders for its clients. According to its own figures, the business has completed more than 185 projects for over 22 different brands, giving it a track record across a range of industries needing uniforms, safety gear or branded promotional items rather than working with only one type of client. Because it covers hospitality clothing and safety wear alongside standard corporate wear, Platinum Clothing and Promotions can serve businesses with varied uniform needs, from front-of-house hospitality staff through to workers needing certified safety clothing, using the same manufacturing and branding process.

Based in Garsfontein, the company serves corporate clients across Pretoria looking for a single supplier to manage uniform and promotional clothing needs from initial order through to branding and final delivery.

Pretoria East Gate Motor Repairs/Installations, based in the Garsfontein Smallholdings area, has been installing, replacing and repairing gate motors around Pretoria East for the past two decades. Its work covers swing gate motor repairs, replacements, supply and installation, along with repairs and installations for Gemini-brand gate motors specifically, as well as garage door motor repairs and services. The business also handles electric fence repairs, installation and replacement, and offers same-day emergency services for electric gate and fence faults, aimed at customers who need a security gate or fence restored to working order quickly.

Beyond its home base in Pretoria East, the company lists coverage extending to Centurion, Midrand, Pretoria North, Montana, Zwavelpoort, Bronkhorstspruit, Waterkloof and Moreleta Park, giving it a service area spanning much of the greater Pretoria and eastern Centurion region rather than only the immediate Garsfontein area. With two decades of experience in gate motor and electric fence work, the business positions itself as a specialist in security-related automation repairs rather than a general handyman or electrician taking on this work alongside other trades.
